GENERIC: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Your account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
CSRF_INVALID: Your session token is out of date. Reload the page and try again.
NOT_FOUND: The item was not found. It may have been deleted.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Check the form and try again.
CONFLICT: The change conflicts with existing data.
DUPLICATE: An item with the same value already exists.
WEAK_PASSWORD: The password does not meet the password policy.
PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must be different from the current one.
EMAIL_TAKEN: This email address is already in use.
CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ACCESS: You cannot deactivate yourself or change your own roles.
LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: At least one active Super Admin is required.
NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name in English or Arabic.
DEPARTMENT_NOT_FOUND: The selected department no longer exists.
DEPARTMENT_IN_USE: This department still has sub-departments, users or processes.
INVALID_PARENT: An item cannot be moved under itself or its own children.
PARENT_NOT_FOUND: The selected parent no longer exists.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file or request is too large.
UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
CODE_TAKEN: Another process already uses this code.
OWNER_NOT_FOUND: The selected owner no longer exists.
CATEGORY_INHERITED: Sub-processes inherit the category of their parent.
PROCESS_HAS_CHILDREN: Delete or move the sub-processes first.
INVALID_BPMN: The diagram is not a valid BPMN 2.0 document.
OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The selected library object no longer exists.
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

INVALID_PRINCIPAL: A selected user, role or department no longer exists.
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: The selected template no longer exists.
PAGE_CHANGED: Someone else saved this page in the meantime.
PROCESS_NOT_FOUND: The selected process no longer exists.
ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISSING: The server has no encryption key for integration tokens (INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY).
GIT_TOKEN_REQUIRED: Enter an access token to enable synchronisation.
GIT_AUTH_FAILED: The access token was rejected. Check that it is valid and not expired.
GIT_REPO_NOT_FOUND: The repository was not found, or the token cannot see it.
GIT_BRANCH_NOT_FOUND: The branch does not exist in the repository.
GIT_NO_PUSH_ACCESS: The token is not allowed to write to this repository.
GIT_RATE_LIMITED: The Git provider is limiting requests. Try again later.
GIT_CONFLICT: The branch changed during the sync. Retry.
GIT_NETWORK: The Git server could not be reached.
GIT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The integration is not fully configured (repository, branch or token missing).
GIT_SOURCE_MISSING: The item to synchronise no longer exists.
